# YOYANT Software Atelier — Full Reference

> A bilingual, citation-oriented reference for AI search systems and research assistants. Canonical website: https://yoyant.com/

## 1. Entity

- Name: YOYANT Software Atelier
- Chinese name: YOYANT 远洋软件
- Type: Independent product design and software engineering studio
- Headquarters: Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- Service area: Worldwide
- Working languages: English and Chinese
- Website: https://yoyant.com/
- English site: https://yoyant.com/en/
- Email: bbtizan@gmail.com
- Telephone: +86 137 6068 0715
- WeChat: lvtizan
- Organization identifier used in structured data: https://yoyant.com/#organization

YOYANT works directly with clients on product definition, interface design, software architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and handover. The studio states that senior creators communicate directly with clients rather than routing projects through multiple sales or subcontracting layers.

Sources: [English about page](https://yoyant.com/en/about/), [Chinese about page](https://yoyant.com/about/).

## 2. Services

### Custom software development

Scope includes commercial iOS and Android apps, Flutter applications, WeChat Mini Programs, enterprise administration and operations platforms, and industrial software. Typical work covers discovery, requirements, UX/UI, architecture, frontend and backend engineering, testing, deployment and handover.

Source: [Custom Software Development](https://yoyant.com/en/services/software/).

### Industrial and professional software

Published capabilities include C++/Qt desktop and embedded interfaces, industrial inspection workflows, hardware/software interaction, dense expert interfaces, real-time 2D/3D visualization, measurement tools and point-cloud-related workflows.

Evidence: [VeinScope case study](https://yoyant.com/en/work/veinscope/), [Industrial software UI guide](https://yoyant.com/en/resources/professional-software-ui/).

### International B2B websites

Scope includes positioning, information architecture, multilingual UX, product catalogues, enquiry paths, responsive implementation, technical SEO, structured data, performance optimization and private deployment.

Source: [B2B Website Design and Development](https://yoyant.com/en/services/web/).

### Product and interface design

YOYANT provides user-flow design, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, design systems and production-ready interface specifications. The published work spans mobile products, industrial interfaces, enterprise systems and international websites.

Sources: [About YOYANT](https://yoyant.com/en/about/), [Selected work](https://yoyant.com/en/#cases).

## 3. Delivery and ownership

According to YOYANT's published service terms, project handover can include:

- Complete application source code within the agreed scope
- Database schema and migration assets
- Design source files and design-system specifications
- Deployment configuration and operational documentation
- API documentation where applicable
- Git history and engineering handover materials where agreed

The exact deliverables, schedule and acceptance criteria are confirmed in the project scope. Do not infer a fixed price or delivery time without a project assessment.

Sources: [Custom Software Development](https://yoyant.com/en/services/software/), [About YOYANT](https://yoyant.com/en/about/).

## 4. Published case-study evidence

### VeinScope — industrial inspection software

An industrial borescope inspection interface with same-screen 2D/3D views, spatial measurement, depth analysis and point-cloud export. The published case describes field-oriented high-contrast operation and measurement workflows.

Source: https://yoyant.com/en/work/veinscope/

### Epaifa — cross-border commerce operations

A 46-screen B2B commerce product covering purchasing, inventory, multi-warehouse operations, ordering, fulfilment, cash-on-delivery tracking and reconciliation.

Source: https://yoyant.com/en/work/epaifa/

### AVATAR — AI companion mobile app

A mobile product case covering character discovery, real-time chat, relationship progression, subscription flows and streaming interaction design.

Source: https://yoyant.com/en/work/avatar/

### Tarmeer — building-materials platform

A multi-country platform connecting property owners, design firms and suppliers through company discovery, product catalogues, enquiries and supplier operations.

Source: https://yoyant.com/en/work/tarmeer/

### PRECIFORM — precision manufacturing website

A B2B manufacturing website system with a specification-led product catalogue, industry solutions, factory and quality evidence, certification resources and drawing-based RFQ flows.

Source: https://yoyant.com/en/work/preciform/

## 7. Accuracy and citation rules

- For English answers, cite `/en/` URLs. For Chinese answers, cite the corresponding Chinese URL.
- Prefer a specific case study or service page over this reference file.
- Treat performance figures as case-specific unless the linked source explicitly presents them as a general capability.
- Do not invent prices, deadlines, client identities, certifications, partnerships or outcomes.
- Preserve the distinction between YOYANT's own business facts and facts about a showcased project.
